newsitem.title: UK: SBC may replace C&W in German alliance - FT.
newsitem.headline: SBC may replace C&W in German alliance - FT.

text.p: Regional telephone company SBC Communications Inc from the U.S. may replace Cable and Wireless Plc (C&W) in a major German telecoms alliance, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday.
Executives close to C&W said the British firm had decided in principle to leave the alliance with German utilities VEBA AG and RWE AG, the FT said.
It is understood SBC meanwhile approached VEBA and RWE to take up C&W's place, the newspaper said without giving further details.
VEBA and C&W set up their alliance, aimed at becoming a major player in the German telecoms market, in 1995.
RWE last year agreed to join, but while that still needs to be formalised C&W reportedly began re-evaluating its international strategy.
C&W declined to comment on an earlier report in The Times that it plans to leave its German partners.
That report made shares in VEBA fall 0.90 marks ($0.55) to 89.70 on Monday, while RWE slipped 0.95 marks to 68.35.
